description.value: Harbour House is a historic waterfront hotel in Ganges, Salt Spring Island, founded in 1916 and fully renovated into a modern island destination. Its public restaurant, Woodley's Kitchen & Bar, serves farm-to-table meals sourced from local Salt Spring Island producers, with two heated patios overlooking Ganges Harbour. Situated a short walk from the famous Ganges Saturday Market and local marinas, it is a prominent landmark at the head of the harbour for cyclists touring Salt Spring Island.

address.value: 121 Upper Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2S2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Harbour House Hotel at 121 Upper Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island — not Chemainus as the OSM community field states, though the coordinates (48.859°N, 123.502°W) do correspond to Ganges/Salt Spring Island, not Chemainus. The public-facing restaurant Woodley's Kitchen & Bar supports the Food & Drink category. The FAQ explicitly confirms complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi 'throughout the hotel,' which encompasses the restaurant area; no website content addresses bike parking, water refill, takeout, or most other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chemainus' but the business is located in Ganges, Salt Spring Island (121 Upper Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2S2). The OSM coordinates do correspond to Salt Spring Island, so the community tag appears miscategorized.
OSM tags this as amenity=restaurant but this is primarily a hotel; the restaurant (Woodley's Kitchen & Bar) is the publicly accessible Food & Drink component.
OSM name is 'Harbour House' but the business operates as 'Harbour House Hotel' / 'Harbour House SSI' on its website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel and public restaurant on Salt Spring Island with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. Woodley's Kitchen & Bar is explicitly open to the public and relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The restaurant Woodley's Kitchen & Bar is confirmed open to the public (FAQ: 'Yes, Woodley's Kitchen | Bar | Patio is open to both hotel guests and the public'). Complimentary on-site parking is available per the FAQ, which may be relevant to cyclists with support vehicles.
